plugins.name: ADOS MAVLink Gimbal v2 Controller
plugins.description: MAVLink Gimbal v2 control: manual sliders, ROI lock-on-target, and an 'Aim at this target' action that keeps the gimbal on a vision-locked detection.
plugins.author: Altnautica

plugins.name: ADOS Follow-Me
plugins.description: Lock onto an operator-designated subject and fly a fixed-distance standoff follow from the companion. A flight Skill in the cockpit Skill Bar, a click-a-target Follow action, and a per-drone settings tab.
plugins.author: Altnautica

plugins.name: ADOS World Engine
plugins.description: 3D world model from drone flights, reconstructed on a LAN compute node, plus perception offload for drones without an NPU.
plugins.author: Altnautica

plugins.name: ADOS SIYI Optical Pod
plugins.description: Native driver for the SIYI optical-pod line (A2 mini, A8 mini, ZR10, ZR30, ZT6, ZT30) with per-model capability negotiation: gimbal, zoom, focus, photo/record, thermal palette and gain, and a laser rangefinder with subject geolocation.
plugins.author: Altnautica

plugins.name: ADOS Vision Navigation
plugins.description: GPS-denied navigation. Optical flow from a downward camera. Supports ArduPilot, PX4, and iNav 7.0+ on USB UVC or CSI cameras.
plugins.author: Altnautica
